# Hpoi cover-matching regression samples

Public Hpoi product photographs retrieved 2026-11-16, reduced to 240 px wide JPEGs for offline algorithm tests. These are comparison fixtures, not site-distributed product assets. `ID-0.jpg` is the collection cover; `ID-1.jpg` through `ID-3.jpg` are the first three official gallery images in observed order.

| Public product page | Matching view among these three | Failure guarded against |
| --- | --- | --- |
| https://www.hpoi.net/hobby/85291 | 2 | correction collage and back view |
| https://www.hpoi.net/hobby/70818 | 2 | packaging box and back view on white background |
| https://www.hpoi.net/hobby/68456 | 1 | different viewpoint |
| https://www.hpoi.net/hobby/128755 | 3 | promotional collage and face close-up |
| https://www.hpoi.net/hobby/77004 | 1 | alternate background and back view |

The complete online galleries may contain later duplicates or closer crops; matching is never hardcoded to these IDs or positions. Original copyright remains with the respective image owners.
